<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Pythagoras Theorem Visual Proof</title>
  
  <defs>
    <!-- Background grid -->
    <pattern id="grid" width="20" height="20" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <path d="M 20 0 L 0 0 0 20" fill="none" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="1"/>
    </pattern>

    <!-- Drop shadow -->
    <filter id="shadow" x="-10%" y="-10%" width="120%" height="120%">
      <feDropShadow dx="2" dy="4" stdDeviation="4" flood-opacity="0.15"/>
    </filter>

    <!-- Arrow marker -->
    <marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="5" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#475569"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <rect width="800" height="500" fill="url(#grid)"/>

  <!-- Title & Subtitle -->
  <text x="400" y="40" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">Pythagoras' Theorem: $a^2 + b^2 = c^2$</text>
  <text x="400" y="65" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">The area of the squares on the two shorter sides equals the area of the square on the hypotenuse.</text>

  <!-- ==================== MAIN GRAPHIC ==================== -->
  
  <!-- Coordinates setup: Triangle vertices at A(250, 320), B(130, 320), C(250, 200) -> wait, let's adjust for nice numbers:
       Let a = 120px (base, side b)
       Let b = 90px (height, side a)
       Let c = 150px (hypotenuse, side c)
       Scale: 1 unit = 1 pixel for square areas or just relative. Let's make triangle legs 120 and 90.
       Vertex 1 (Right angle): (220, 320)
       Vertex 2 (Left): (220 - 120 = 100, 320) -> length b = 120
       Vertex 3 (Top): (220, 320 - 90 = 230) -> length a = 90
       Hypotenuse runs from (100, 320) to (220, 230). Length c = 150.
       Let's shift everything right and down for better centering:
       Right angle at (240, 330)
       Left vertex: (120, 330) -> distance 120
       Top vertex: (240, 240) -> distance 90
       Hypotenuse: from (120, 330) to (240, 240) -> distance 150.
  -->

  <!-- GROUP FOR LEFT/BOTTOM/TOP SQUARES & TRIANGLE -->
  <g transform="translate(40, 20)" filter="url(#shadow)">
    
    <!-- Square on side b (bottom, width 120, height 120, downwards from y=330) -->
    <rect x="120" y="330" width="120" height="120" fill="#fed7aa" stroke="#fb923c" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="180" y="395" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#c2410c" text-anchor="middle">b²</text>
    <text x="180" y="415" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#9a3412" text-anchor="middle">120² = 14400</text>

    <!-- Square on side a (left, width 90, height 90, leftwards from x=120) -->
    <rect x="30" y="240" width="90" height="90" fill="#bfdbfe" stroke="#60a5fa" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="75" y="290" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#1d4ed8" text-anchor="middle">a²</text>
    <text x="75" y="310" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#1e40af" text-anchor="middle">90² = 8100</text>

    <!-- Square on hypotenuse c (built outwards to the top-left) -->
    <!-- Vector from (120,330) to (240,240) is (120, -90). Perpendicular pointing outwards (top-left) is (-90, -120).
         Corner 1: (120, 330)
         Corner 2: (240, 240)
         Corner 3: (240 - 90, 240 - 120) = (150, 120)
         Corner 4: (120 - 90, 330 - 120) = (30, 210)
    -->
    <polygon points="120,330 240,240 150,120 30,210" fill="#bbf7d0" stroke="#4ade80" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="135" y="225" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#15803d" text-anchor="middle">c²</text>
    <text x="135" y="245" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#166534" text-anchor="middle">150² = 22500</text>

    <!-- The Central Right-Angled Triangle -->
    <polygon points="120,330 240,330 240,240" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    
    <!-- Right angle symbol -->
    <polyline points="225,330 225,315 240,315" fill="none" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="2"/>

    <!-- Triangle Side Labels -->
    <text x="180" y="355" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#334155" text-anchor="middle">b = 12 cm</text>
    <text x="260" y="285" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#334155" text-anchor="start">a = 9 cm</text>
    <text x="165" y="270" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#15803d" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-36.87 165 270)">c = 15 cm</text>

  </g>

  <!-- ==================== LABELS & ANNOTATIONS ==================== -->
  
  <!-- Label pointers / Highlights -->
  <g font-family="system-ui, sans-serif">
    <!-- Hypotenuse label -->
    <line x1="210" y1="230" x2="270" y2="180" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
    <rect x="270" y="165" width="130" height="30" rx="4" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <text x="335" y="185" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a" text-anchor="middle">Hypotenuse (c)</text>
    <text x="335" y="200" font-size="11" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">Longest side, opposite right angle</text>

    <!-- Right angle label -->
    <line x1="280" y1="350" x2="330" y2="390" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>
    <rect x="330" y="380" width="110" height="26" rx="4" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <text x="385" y="398" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#0f172a" text-anchor="middle">Right Angle (90°)</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== ANIMATED CONCEPT PANEL ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(480, 100)" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="280" height="350" rx="8" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="2" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    
    <text x="140" y="35" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">Area Breakdown</text>
    
    <!-- Formula breakdown items -->
    <g transform="translate(20, 60)">
      <!-- a squared block -->
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="30" height="30" rx="4" fill="#bfdbfe" stroke="#60a5fa" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="15" y="20" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1d4ed8" text-anchor="middle">a²</text>
      <text x="45" y="20" font-size="15" fill="#334155">=</text>
      <text x="65" y="20" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#1d4ed8">9²</text>
      <text x="120" y="20" font-size="15" fill="#64748b">=</text>
      <text x="145" y="20" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">81 cm²</text>
    </g>

    <g transform="translate(20, 110)">
      <!-- b squared block -->
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="30" height="30" rx="4" fill="#fed7aa" stroke="#fb923c" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="15" y="20" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#c2410c" text-anchor="middle">b²</text>
      <text x="45" y="20" font-size="15" fill="#334155">=</text>
      <text x="65" y="20" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#c2410c">12²</text>
      <text x="120" y="20" font-size="15" fill="#64748b">=</text>
      <text x="145" y="20" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">144 cm²</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Divider line -->
    <line x1="20" y1="160" x2="260" y2="160" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="2"/>

    <!-- Sum block -->
    <g transform="translate(20, 180)">
      <text x="15" y="20" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">a² + b²</text>
      <text x="85" y="20" font-size="16" fill="#334155">=</text>
      <text x="110" y="20" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b">81 + 144</text>
      <text x="25" y="50" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2563eb">=</text>
      <text x="50" y="50" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#2563eb">225 cm²</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Final c squared result -->
    <g transform="translate(20, 260)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="60" rx="6" fill="#dcfce7" stroke="#4ade80" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="120" y="25" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#166534" text-anchor="middle">Therefore, c² = 225</text>
      <text x="120" y="47" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#15803d" text-anchor="middle">c = √225 = 15 cm</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== ANIMATION ==================== -->
  <!-- We pulse/highlight the hypotenuse square and the text to draw attention -->
  <style>
    @keyframes pulseGlow {
      0% { opacity: 0.7; transform: scale(1); }
      50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.02); stroke-width: 4px; }
      100% { opacity: 0.7; transform: scale(1); }
    }
    .anim-square {
      transform-origin: 135px 210px;
      animation: pulseGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
  </style>
  
  <!-- Applying animation group over hypotenuse square -->
  <g class="anim-square">
    <polygon points="120,330 240,240 150,120 30,210" fill="none" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="3" pointer-events="none"/>
  </g>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Parts of a Circle</title>
  
  <defs>
    <!-- Styles for smooth rendering and animations -->
    <style>
      .title { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 26px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1e293b; text-anchor: middle; }
      .subtitle { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; fill: #475569; text-anchor: middle; }
      .label { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; fill: #0f172a; }
      .sublabel { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; fill: #334155; }
      
      .circle-bg { fill: #f8fafc; stroke: #cbd5e1; stroke-width: 3; }
      .main-circle { fill: #e0f2fe; stroke: #0284c7; stroke-width: 4; }
      
      .radius-line { stroke: #10b981; stroke-width: 4; stroke-dasharray: 6,4; }
      .diameter-line { stroke: #f59e0b; stroke-width: 4; }
      .centre-point { fill: #ef4444; }
      
      .box { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #e2e8f0; stroke-width: 2; rx: 8; ry: 8; filter: drop-shadow(0px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)); }
    </style>

    <!-- Marker for circumference path animation -->
    <marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="5" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#8b5cf6"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- Header -->
  <text x="400" y="40" class="title">Parts of a Circle</text>
  <text x="400" y="65" class="subtitle">Visualising the Centre, Radius, Diameter, and Circumference</text>

  <!-- MAIN GRAPHIC AREA (Left-Centre) -->
  <g transform="translate(260, 280)">
    <!-- Main Circle -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="150" class="main-circle" />

    <!-- Diameter (Horizontal, passes through centre) -->
    <line x1="-150" y1="0" x2="150" y2="0" class="diameter-line" />
    
    <!-- Radius (From centre to top-right edge) -->
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="106" y2="-106" class="radius-line" />

    <!-- Circumference Tracer (Animated Dashed Path around the edge) -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="150" fill="none" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="5" stroke-dasharray="942" stroke-dashoffset="942">
      <animate attributeName="stroke-dashoffset" from="942" to="0" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>

    <!-- Centre Point -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="6" class="centre-point" />
    <!-- Pulse ring for centre -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2">
      <animate attributeName="r" values="6;20;6" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0;1" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
  </g>

  <!-- LABELS & EXPLANATIONS (Right Side) -->
  
  <!-- 1. Centre Box -->
  <g transform="translate(480, 110)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="290" height="65" class="box" />
    <circle cx="25" cy="32" r="6" class="centre-point" />
    <text x="45" y="27" class="label">Centre</text>
    <text x="45" y="48" class="sublabel">The exact middle point</text>
  </g>

  <!-- 2. Radius Box -->
  <g transform="translate(480, 185)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="290" height="65" class="box" />
    <line x1="10" y1="32" x2="40" y2="32" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="4,2" />
    <text x="55" y="27" class="label">Radius</text>
    <text x="55" y="48" class="sublabel">Centre to edge (r)</text>
  </g>

  <!-- 3. Diameter Box -->
  <g transform="translate(480, 260)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="290" height="65" class="box" />
    <line x1="10" y1="32" x2="40" y2="32" class="diameter-line" />
    <text x="55" y="27" class="label">Diameter</text>
    <text x="55" y="48" class="sublabel">Across through centre (d = 2r)</text>
  </g>

  <!-- 4. Circumference Box -->
  <g transform="translate(480, 335)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="290" height="65" class="box" />
    <circle cx="25" cy="32" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="4" />
    <text x="45" y="27" class="label">Circumference</text>
    <text x="45" y="48" class="sublabel">The distance around the edge</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Direct pointer labels on the diagram (Left side) -->
  <g>
    <!-- Centre Label Pointer -->
    <text x="235" y="255" class="label" text-anchor="end" font-size="14">Centre</text>
    <line x1="243" y1="260" x2="252" y2="275" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="1.5" />

    <!-- Radius Label Pointer -->
    <text x="350" y="190" class="label" font-size="14" fill="#047857">Radius</text>
    <line x1="335" y1="195" x2="315" y2="210" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="1.5" />

    <!-- Diameter Label Pointer -->
    <text x="110" y="265" class="label" font-size="14" fill="#b45309">Diameter</text>
    <line x1="170" y1="280" x2="195" y2="280" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="1.5" />

    <!-- Circumference Label Pointer -->
    <text x="140" y="115" class="label" font-size="14" fill="#7c3aed">Circumference</text>
    <path d="M 200 135 Q 170 120 150 145" fill="none" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
  </g>

  <!-- Footer Formula Helper -->
  <g transform="translate(260, 440)">
    <rect x="-140" y="0" width="280" height="40" rx="20" ry="20" fill="#f1f5f9" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="0" y="25" font-family="'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#334155" text-anchor="middle">
      Diameter = 2 × Radius <tspan fill="#64748b" font-weight="normal">(d = 2r)</tspan>
    </text>
  </g>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Photosynthesis in Plants</title>
  
  <!-- CSS Animations -->
  <style>
    @keyframes pulse {
      0% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.8; }
      50% { transform: scale(1.05); opacity: 1; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(255,215,0,0.8)); }
      100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.8; }
    }
    @keyframes floatUp {
      0% { transform: translateY(0px) scale(0.8); opacity: 0; }
      20% { opacity: 0.9; }
      80% { opacity: 0.9; }
      100% { transform: translateY(-160px) scale(1.2); opacity: 0; }
    }
    @keyframes floatDown {
      0% { transform: translateY(-140px) scale(1.2); opacity: 0; }
      20% { opacity: 0.9; }
      80% { opacity: 0.9; }
      100% { transform: translateY(0px) scale(0.8); opacity: 0; }
    }
    @keyframes sunray {
      0% { opacity: 0.3; transform: rotate(0deg); }
      50% { opacity: 0.7; transform: rotate(5deg); }
      100% { opacity: 0.3; transform: rotate(0deg); }
    }
    @keyframes sway {
      0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      50% { transform: rotate(1.5deg); }
    }

    .sun-animated {
      animation: pulse 3s infinite ease-in-out;
      transform-origin: 110px 90px;
    }
    .sun-rays {
      animation: sunray 4s infinite ease-in-out;
      transform-origin: 110px 90px;
    }
    .plant-sway {
      animation: sway 5s infinite ease-in-out;
      transform-origin: 400px 420px;
    }
    
    .co2-particle-1 { animation: floatDown 3.5s infinite linear; }
    .co2-particle-2 { animation: floatDown 3.5s infinite linear; animation-delay: 1.7s; }
    
    .o2-particle-1 { animation: floatUp 3.5s infinite linear; }
    .o2-particle-2 { animation: floatUp 3.5s infinite linear; animation-delay: 1.7s; }

    .label-box {
      fill: #ffffff;
      stroke: #2b7a0b;
      stroke-width: 2;
      rx: 8;
    }
    
    .text-title { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; fill: #1b4332; }
    .text-body { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; fill: #2d3748; }
    .text-label { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 15px; fill: #1b4332; }
  </style>

  <!-- Background Gradient -->
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="skyGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#e0f7fa" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#f1f8e9" />
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="soilGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8d6e63" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5d4037" />
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="sunGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffeb3b" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ff9800" />
    </linearGradient>
    <marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="5" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#2b7a0b"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <rect width="800" height="500" fill="url(#skyGrad)" />
  
  <!-- Soil / Ground -->
  <rect x="0" y="400" width="800" height="100" fill="url(#soilGrad)" />
  <path d="M0 400 Q 200 390, 400 400 T 800 400" fill="none" stroke="#4e342e" stroke-width="4" />

  <!-- Title banner area -->
  <rect x="220" y="15" width="360" height="45" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#a5d6a7" stroke-width="2" />
  <text x="400" y="44" text-anchor="middle" font-family="'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" class="text-title">Photosynthesis in Plants</text>

  <!-- SUN & LIGHT ENERGY -->
  <g class="sun-rays" stroke="#ffb300" stroke-dasharray="6,6" stroke-width="3">
    <line x1="110" y1="90" x2="220" y2="180" />
    <line x1="110" y1="90" x2="260" y2="140" />
    <line x1="110" y1="90" x2="180" y2="230" />
  </g>
  <circle cx="110" cy="90" r="40" fill="url(#sunGrad)" class="sun-animated" />
  
  <!-- Sun Label & Rays description -->
  <text x="110" y="145" text-anchor="middle" font-family="'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="bold" font-size="14" fill="#e65100">Light Energy</text>
  <path d="M 155 105 Q 220 140, 290 180" fill="none" stroke="#ffa726" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="5,5" />

  <!-- PLANT GROUP (Swaying slightly) -->
  <g class="plant-sway">
    <!-- Roots -->
    <path d="M 400 400 Q 370 430, 340 450" fill="none" stroke="#8d6e63" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <path d="M 400 400 Q 430 430, 460 460" fill="none" stroke="#8d6e63" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <path d="M 400 400 Q 400 440, 390 470" fill="none" stroke="#8d6e63" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" />

    <!-- Stem / Trunk -->
    <path d="M 400 410 Q 395 300, 400 220" fill="none" stroke="#2e7d32" stroke-width="16" stroke-linecap="round" />

    <!-- Leaves (Chloroplasts / Chlorophyll context) -->
    <!-- Left Leaf -->
    <path d="M 395 280 C 330 260, 270 300, 310 350 C 350 370, 380 320, 395 280 Z" fill="#66bb6a" stroke="#2e7d32" stroke-width="3" />

svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>States of Matter - GCSE Chemistry</title>

  <style>
    .bg { fill: #f8fafc; }
    .container { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #cbd5e1; stroke-width: 2; rx: 12; }
    .header { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1e293b; text-anchor: middle; }
    .subtext { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; fill: #475569; text-anchor: middle; }
    .label { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; fill: #0f172a; text-anchor: middle; }
    .arrow { stroke: #64748b; stroke-width: 3; fill: none; marker-end: url(#arrowhead); }
    
    /* Solid particle vibration */
    @keyframes vibrate {
      0% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); }
      20% { transform: translate(-1px, 1px); }
      40% { transform: translate(1px, -1px); }
      60% { transform: translate(-1px, -1px); }
      80% { transform: translate(1px, 1px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0px, 0px); }
    }
    .vibrating-particle {
      animation: vibrate 0.2s infinite linear;
    }

    /* Liquid particle drift */
    @keyframes flow1 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      50% { transform: translate(12px, -8px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes flow2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      50% { transform: translate(-10px, 12px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    .flow-1 { animation: flow1 3s infinite ease-in-out; }
    .flow-2 { animation: flow2 3.5s infinite ease-in-out; }

    /* Gas particle fast movement */
    @keyframes bounce1 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(25px, -20px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-15px, -35px); }
      75% { transform: translate(20px, 15px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes bounce2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(-30px, 15px); }
      50% { transform: translate(20px, 25px); }
      75% { transform: translate(-20px, -15px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes bounce3 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(20px, 30px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-30px, -15px); }
      75% { transform: translate(-10px, 20px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }
    .gas-1 { animation: bounce1 1.2s infinite linear; }
    .gas-2 { animation: bounce2 1.5s infinite linear; }
    .gas-3 { animation: bounce3 1.0s infinite linear; }
  </style>

  <defs>
    <marker id="arrowhead" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="9" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
      <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" fill="#64748b"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="500" class="bg"/>

  <!-- Main Title -->
  <text x="400" y="35" class="header">States of Matter</text>
  <text x="400" y="55" class="subtext">How particles are arranged and move in solids, liquids, and gases</text>

  <!-- ==================== SOLID ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(30, 80)">
    <rect width="220" height="290" class="container"/>
    <text x="110" y="30" class="label">SOLID</text>
    <text x="110" y="245" class="subtext">Close together</text>
    <text x="110" y="265" class="subtext">Vibrate in fixed positions</text>

    <!-- Solid Particles (Regular lattice) -->
    <g transform="translate(45, 60)">
      <!-- Row 1 -->
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="12" fill="#3b82f6" class="vibrating-particle"/>
      <circle cx="30" cy="0" r="12" fill="#3b82f6" class="vibrating-particle" style="animation-delay: 0.05s"/>
      <circle cx="60" cy="0" r="12" fill="#3b82f6" class="vibrating-particle" style="animation-delay: 0.1s"/>
      
      <!-- Row 2 -->
      <circle cx="0" cy="30" r="12" fill="#3b82f6" class="vibrating-particle" style="animation-delay: 0.15s"/>
      <circle cx="30" cy="30" r="12" fill="#3b82f6" class="vibrating-particle" style="animation-delay: 0.02s"/>
      <circle cx="60" cy="30" r="12" fill="#3b82f6" class="vibrating-particle" style="animation-delay: 0.08s"/>

      <!-- Row 3 -->
      <circle cx="0" cy="60" r="12" fill="#3b82f6" class="vibrating-particle" style="animation-delay: 0.07s"/>
      <circle cx="30" cy="60" r="12" fill="#3b82f6" class="vibrating-particle" style="animation-delay: 0.12s"/>
      <circle cx="60" cy="60" r="12" fill="#3b82f6" class="vibrating-particle" style="animation-delay: 0.03s"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== LIQUID ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(290, 80)">
    <rect width="220" height="290" class="container"/>
    <text x="110" y="30" class="label">LIQUID</text>
    <text x="110" y="245" class="subtext">Close, but random</text>
    <text x="110" y="265" class="subtext">Move past each other</text>

    <!-- Liquid Particles (Irregular, flowing) -->
    <g transform="translate(45, 60)">
      <circle cx="10" cy="10" r="12" fill="#10b981" class="flow-1"/>
      <circle cx="45" cy="15" r="12" fill="#10b981" class="flow-2"/>
      <circle cx="75" cy="5"  r="12" fill="#10b981" class="flow-1" style="animation-delay: -1s"/>
      
      <circle cx="20" cy="40" r="12" fill="#10b981" class="flow-2" style="animation-delay: -1.5s"/>
      <circle cx="55" cy="45" r="12" fill="#10b981" class="flow-1" style="animation-delay: -0.5s"/>
      
      <circle cx="5"  cy="75" r="12" fill="#10b981" class="flow-1" style="animation-delay: -2s"/>
      <circle cx="38" cy="70" r="12" fill="#10b981" class="flow-2" style="animation-delay: -0.8s"/>
      <circle cx="70" cy="75" r="12" fill="#10b981" class="flow-1" style="animation-delay: -1.8s"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== GAS ==================== -->
  <g transform="translate(550, 80)">
    <rect width="220" height="290" class="container"/>
    <text x="110" y="30" class="label">GAS</text>
    <text x="110" y="245" class="subtext">Far apart</text>
    <text x="110" y="265" class="subtext">Fast & random motion</text>

    <!-- Gas Particles (Spread out, fast bouncing) -->
    <g transform="translate(55, 60)">
      <circle cx="10" cy="10" r="12" fill="#f59e0b" class="gas-1"/>
      <circle cx="90" cy="20" r="12" fill="#f59e0b" class="gas-2"/>
      <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="12" fill="#f59e0b" class="gas-3"/>
      <circle cx="20" cy="80" r="12" fill="#f59e0b" class="gas-2" style="animation-delay: -0.4s"/>
      <circle cx="85" cy="75" r="12" fill="#f59e0b" class="gas-1" style="animation-delay: -0.7s"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Transition Arrows & Labels -->
  <path d="M 255 210 Q 272 195 288 210" class="arrow"/>
  <path d="M 515 210 Q 532 195 548 210" class="arrow"/>

  <text x="271" y="180" class="subtext" font-size="12">Heat</text>
  <text x="531" y="180" class="subtext" font-size="12">Heat</text>

  <!-- Footer hint (kept safely inside viewBox) -->
  <text x="400" y="420" class="subtext" font-style="italic">Notice how spacing increases and movement becomes more energetic from solid to gas.</text>
</svg>
